enchantment.redomesticate.amphibious.des: Attunes your companion to the water enhancing their swimming skills and lung capacity.
enchantment.redomesticate.deflection.des: Grants your companion a magic barrier to deflect all physical projectiles; Sister rune to Trickster.
enchantment.redomesticate.frost_fang.des: Imbues your companion's strike with a cryonic essence to slow down enemies.
enchantment.redomesticate.healing_aura.d: Allows your companion to heal you and others around them.
enchantment.redomesticate.health_boost.d: Enhances the stature and vitality of your companion.
Transfers all damage your companion takes to you instead.
enchantment.redomesticate.immunity_frame: Protects your companion for a time after an attack; Sister rune to Royal Guard.
enchantment.redomesticate.tethered_telep: Grants your companion the ability to walk between worlds.
message.redomesticate.wayward_lantern_re: %s has found its way to a nearby Wayward Lantern.
